notes.title: Update v.0.9.1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, a new update is now available with the following changes:

[h2]Gameplay, Rules & Options[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added extra time and penalties. 
[*] Added difficulty settings. 
[*] Added button combo to fist-pass over the bar (instead of to a team-mate) \[RT+A / R2+X].
[*] Fixed scores not registering after fouls (removed soft-lock case).
[*] Fixed hand-pass into goal causing a soft-lock.
[*] Double bounce now correctly called as travelling; correct player resumes play.
[*] Players now release the ball when knocked to the ground to prevent travelling foul.
[*] Players can move towards the ball correctly when catching.
[*] Reduced probabilities of cards and injuries.
[/list]

[h2]Set Pieces & Match Events[/h2]
[h3]Frees[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed kicks sometimes going backwards.
[*] Takers now face the correct direction once given.
[*] Goalkeeper now takes frees close to goal when appropriate.
[*] Added stinger to mask moving an inside-13m free to the 13m line.
[*] Nets and other obstructing objects fade out for clear visibility.
[*] Prevented players encroaching on free taker. 
[/list]
[h3]Throw-ins[/h3]
[list]
[*] Contesting players react better to each other.
[*] Non-participants wait before moving towards centre.
[*] Timing of throw-in actions improved.
[/list]
[h3]Sidelines[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed AI sideline takers getting stuck.
[*] Ensured the ball is kicked back into play.
[*] Linesmen no longer crowd the kick taker.
[/list]
[h3]Penalties[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed goalkeeper auto-dives choosing the wrong direction.
[/list]

[h2]AI, Animation & Player Behaviour[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved AI goal-kick choices.
[*] Increased hard-tackle animation speed.
[*] Goalkeepers recover to position faster after actions.
[/list]

[h2]Career, Tournaments & Simulation[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added injuries/suspensions.
[*] Generates new players at end of season.
[*] Now able to see player detail panel for newly generated players. 
[*] Added end-of-year stingers to notify season end.
[*] Resolved some player positions showing as “N/A” in simmed matches.
[*] Prevented suspended players being subbed on during simmed matches.
[*] Fixed custom leagues mishandling an odd number of teams.
[*] Ensured worst 3rd-placed team is replaced by New York where applicable.
[*] Correctly highlight teams in knockout tournaments.
[*] Added UI notice when playing as New York and not involved in certain stages.
[*] Fixed Team Management tab breaking in Full Season/Career if no player team is selected.
[*] Fixed returning to Main Menu from a tournament leaving tournament data in memory.
[/list]

[h2]UI/UX & Controls[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Game Settings to the Pre-Game Options scene (Gameplay/Graphics/Audio).
[*] Button prompts now adapt to platform and controller.
[*] Fixed occasional inability to navigate the Main Menu.
[*] Team Creator lineup display rotated to match other screens.
[*] Fixed graphical issues with kit select.
[*] Fixed soft-lock when disconnecting a controller.
[/list]

[h2]Audio[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added audio volume settings.
[*] Added missing UI SFX in Creator Centre, Tournaments, Career menu, and Team Select.
[/list]

[h2]Visuals & Presentation[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed visuals of Main Menu background and Pre-Game Menu scene.
[*] Changed visuals of tournaments scene.
[*] Improved jersey and shorts visuals. 
[*] Added varied ad boards around pitches.
[*] Fixed pitch-side colliders to prevent the ball passing through the ground.
[/list]

[h2]Stability & Performance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed occasional freezes during match loading.
[*] Improved match load times and reduced disk space usage.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v.0.8.22 - Careers and Tournaments
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, a new update is now available with the following changes:

[h2]Gameplay & Mechanics
[/h2][list]
[*] Major overhaul to catching logic: players now reposition more intelligently and can override auto-catch with the new Super Cancel input. (RB+RT or R1+R2)
[*] Kicking, passing, and shooting systems refined for better accuracy and control.
[*] Penalty shootouts upgraded with improved aim/power feedback and goalkeeper dive logic.
[*] Players can no longer encroach on set plays like frees or goal kicks.
[*] Substitutions now occur during natural transitions, with a hard cap of five per match.
[/list]

[h2]Visuals & UI
[/h2][list]
[*] Lighting system improved for better visual fidelity. 
[*] Enhanced grass mow line visuals. 
[*] Stadium smoke and flares now trigger dynamically during game.
[*] Home team colours now reflected in stadium seating for added immersion.
[*] Crowd flags updated to display team crests.
[/list]

[h2]Commentary & Audio
[/h2][list]
[*] Real commentary introduced (early implementation – still in progress).
[*] Improved crowd audio responses for scores, misses, and key events.
[/list]

[h2]Customisation & Modes
[/h2][list]
[*] Create your own teams and bring them into matches.
[*] Career mode and tournament modes introduced.
[*] Steam Remote Play has been fixed to work correctly.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes
[/h2][list]
[*] Injuries and substitutions now work as expected. 
[*] Various goalkeeper fixes and improvements.
[*] Fixed free kick direction issues.
[*] Corrected player indicator and team selection input errors.
[*] Resolved snapping issues with pickup and catch mechanics.
[*] Stopped referees from blocking play and players spawning inappropriately.
[*] Extensive performance improvements on textures. 
[*] Correctly rendered crest images in player name and stamina UI bars.
[*] Improved UI focus and scroll behaviour in player stats and team creation views.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v.0.8.18
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, a new update is now available with the following changes:

Gameplay & Mechanics
•    Introduced new kick animations.
•    Kick angle now directly affects both accuracy and power.
•    Fixed issue with short set pieces not following intended aim direction.
•    Added support for low and angled catches.
•    Catching now respects the direction the player is holding the stick.
•    Resolved bug where players continued tackling after a foul was called.
•    Prevented defenders from catching the ball illegally inside the "D".
•    Corrected strange velocities and angles when taking free kicks.
•    Fixed players incorrectly performing fist passes from a free.
•    Ensured injured players are no longer selected to take free kicks.
•    Addressed logic around incorrect player taking frees when placed on ground.
•    Enhanced handling of ball deflections.
•    Removed injured players from the pitch after injury.
•    Improved goalkeeper behaviour and positioning logic.
•    Adjusted AI decision-making for point kicks based on kick parameters.
•    Fixed issue where AI was selecting teammates too far away for passes.

Visuals & UI
•    Brand new main menu scene implemented.
•    Multiple lighting enhancements across scenes.
•    Player indicator now remains visible when player is off-screen and is relative to the player's head.
•    Fixed issue where the game appeared frozen if paused during stinger transitions.
•    Enabled character rotation in all panels of the kit creator.
•    Player photos now integrated into UI.
•    Default team crests are now displayed correctly.

Player Customisation
•    Player face appearances are now randomized.
•    Adjusted body proportions for more realistic builds.
•    Boots are now randomized per player.
•    Jerseys may now appear tucked randomly.
•    Gloves are now added to players.
•    Hair styles are randomized for variety.
•    Hair colours reassigned for more natural appearances.
